user.title: Log in to LocoGPS
user.description: Log in with your LocoGPS account. Your password is not stored, Home Assistant gets its own access key instead.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in again
reauth_confirm.description: The access for {email} has expired or was revoked. Log in once more and everything continues to work.

error.invalid_auth: Email or password is not correct.
error.two_factor: Accounts with two-factor login are not supported yet.
error.rate_limited: Too many login attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
error.cannot_connect: The LocoGPS server cannot be reached right now.

abort.already_configured: This LocoGPS account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: Please log in with the account that is already set up.

update_failed.message: LocoGPS cannot be reached right now ({error}).
